get.description:
Lists every registered forwarder-module collector (the picker
feed), each tagged with status "online" or "offline". Only
online ones can currently receive a config push.

put.description:
Forwards a base64-encoded PEM cert/key/(optional CA) triple
to agent-manager's reserved __tls_certs__ SetCollectorConfig
channel (action:"apply") and blocks until the forwarder
acknowledges. The backend never encrypts this payload —
agent-manager seals it before relaying to the forwarder.
put.summary: Push cert/key/(optional CA) certificates to a forwarder

get.description:
Reads back the collector_integration_config row agent-manager
already persisted for this (collector, data_type) pair — a
pure read, no CollectorStream push involved. configured=false
means the integration was never remotely enabled/disabled for
this collector.
get.summary: Get the persisted desired-state config of a data-type integration

put.description:
Pushes a remote config to the forwarder collector via
agent-manager's SetCollectorConfig RPC and blocks until the
collector acknowledges (or the request times out).
put.summary: Enable or disable a data-type integration on a forwarder

get.description:
Queries the forwarder's on-disk TLS certificate state via
the same reserved __tls_certs__ channel (action:"status").
No secret material travels in the response.
get.summary: Get a forwarder collector's current TLS certificate status

get.description: Per dataset: the day a record is deleted, and the day it moves to cold storage when the instance has any.

put.description: keepDays is the whole lifetime; coldDays is when records move to object storage and must be shorter. A dataset that already moves records cannot go back to local-only without rebuilding its table.

get.description: Configured means a bucket is written; ready means the store has picked it up. Only ready allows a dataset to move records there. The credentials are never returned.

newValue.description: compact JSON of the changed fields

dataType.description: wineventlog, o365, aws-cloudtrail… empty means every type in the dataset

x-enum-comments.CheckError: the check could not run, which is not the same as failing it
x-enum-comments.CheckNotApplicable: the tenant receives no data of this type

x-enum-comments.RuleThresholdMax: pass if count <= ruleValue; 0 means "none allowed"

x-enum-comments.StatusAtRisk: passing analysis but weak coverage (or vice-versa)
x-enum-comments.StatusNotCovered: nothing is watching this: no checks and no covering rules
x-enum-comments.StatusNotEvaluated: checks exist but the tenant receives no such data
x-enum-comments.StatusOutOfScope: governance control — not provable from logs
x-enum-comments.StatusPending: check declared but not yet written

x-enum-comments.ScopeData: technical — evaluated via checks and/or rule coverage
x-enum-comments.ScopeGovernance: policy/process — not provable from logs; out of scope, excluded from score

alertCount.description:
AlertCount is filled in on list reads; it is not a column. The list shows
how big each incident is, and loading every linked row to count them would
be the whole table to render one number per line.

dimension.description: what it is broken down by

reportLogoUrl.description: logo embedded in report PDFs (legacy REPORT)

accentColor.description: brand primary color (CSS color, e.g. #8b5cf6); drives --primary

reportLogoUrl.description: logo embedded in report PDFs (legacy REPORT)

dataType.description: why a NOT_APPLICABLE check could not run

required.description: the rule's threshold, so "0 of 1 required" reads on its own

activity.description: # alerts from those rules in the window

coverage.description: # enabled correlation rules covering this control

evidence.description: one-line reason for the table; the detail is in Checks

alertList.description:
Capped because nothing else caps it: the rows are written in one
transaction, and an unbounded list is a request that holds a Postgres
transaction open for as long as the caller likes.

sid.description: required when source=windows; enforced in usecase

configured.description:
Configured reports whether this tenant has any configuration group for
the integration. It replaces the stored active flag, which said only
that somebody had pressed a switch.

provider_id.description:
ProviderID names the directory to bind against when the user picked one.
Absent, every active directory of the tenant is tried, which is what a
single-directory install wants.

tfa_type.description:
Which factor the user must produce, so the screen can say "check your
mail" or "open your authenticator" instead of guessing.

maxAIRequests.description:
Raw, because the cap is a tri-state and a *int only carries two: a JSON
null and an absent field both decode to nil. Read it with AILimit.

inherited.description:
Inherited reports that this is the instance default rather than the
tenant's own, so the UI can say so and offer to stop inheriting — or, if
it already has its own, offer to go back.

remaining.description: absent when there is no limit
